records.issue_text: Relative URL to absolute conversion only handles leading-slash forms, leaving relative (page2.html), protocol-relative (//cdn...), and non-default-port URLs broken
records.rationale: `TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls` only rewrites links/images when `href`/`src` `start_with?('/')` (see `if href.present? && href.start_with?('/')` and same for `src`), so other relative forms like `page2.html` (no leading slash) and protocol-relative `//cdn...` will not be converted despite the comment “Convert any relative URLs to absolute.” This can leave embedded/imported HTML with broken resource URLs. Note: the finding’s “non-default-port URLs broken” sub-claim is not supported because the code explicitly appends `:#{uri.port}` when port is not 80/443.
records.stripped_text: Relative URL to absolute conversion only handles leading-slash forms, leaving relative (page2.html), protocol-relative (//cdn...), and non-default-port URLs broken

records.issue_text: PollFeed loop lacks per-item error handling; one bad feed item (nil i.content in Atom feeds) permanently blocks subsequent items, especially with retry: false
records.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the loop does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` inside `rss.items.each`. If a feed item has `i.content == nil` (common in some Atom/RSS variants), calling `.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError`, aborting the job and preventing later items in the same poll from being processed. This is amplified by `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so a failure won’t be retried immediately and can repeatedly block progress on subsequent scheduled runs if the bad item remains.
